column5: I loved the bright red with arrow going up! It's a great eye catcher on my home screen!  It gets your attention! Also the words ( FOLLOW THROUGH ) We all make goals, that's the easy part, but Following Through  is the hard part & being consistent!!! I normally  don't  write or do journals, or write anything down.

Goal detail process is good, but often my goals will have multiple steps. Say to run a marathon id have sub goals to run a 5k, then a 10k and a half. I could make a goal for each but I'd prefer to see my progress to my end goal. Maybe when I detail my goal I could already create the steps to reach out, which will cascade as sub goals which I can edit, as it delete later. 

I'd also like to uncheck my goal if I accidentally check it as complete.

Need a summary page of completed goals as a sort of showcase of my achievements.

column5:
The purpose of the tool was not clear to me at the beginning. However, after interacting with it, its functionality became much clearer. It would be helpful to include a brief introduction upfront explaining what the tool is, how it should be used, and the value it provides to users. Understanding the benefits from the start would help set expectations and encourage engagement.

For the first question, I was not aware that I could type my response. Adding a visible text box or an indicator that shows users can enter a typed response would make the experience more intuitive and reduce initial confusion.
